name: Learned and physics-informed simulation
name_zh: 學習式與物理導向模擬
label: Simulation
line: Neural cellular automata, graph networks and warm-started solvers that put wind, heat and daylight inside the design loop.
line_zh: 以神經細胞自動機、圖神經網路與熱啟動求解器，將風、熱與光的模擬置入設計迴圈之內。
summary: Neural cellular automata, graph networks and warm-started solvers that put wind, heat and daylight inside the design loop instead of after it.
summary_zh: 以神經細胞自動機、圖神經網路與熱啟動求解器，將風、熱與光的模擬置入設計迴圈之內，而非設計之後。
description: Early-stage design proceeds by repeated change. Conventional simulation is too slow to follow it, so analysis arrives after the decisions it should have informed. This thread builds learned surrogates and physics-informed models that respond in real time to a changing geometry: modular neural cellular automata for ventilation and wind, physics-informed graph networks for building morphology and urban open space, and open-data tools for heat-aware walking in the city.
description_zh: 設計初期由反覆修改推進；傳統模擬速度跟不上，分析往往在決策之後才抵達。此脈絡建構能即時回應幾何變動的學習式代理模型與物理導向模型：用於通風與風場的模組化神經細胞自動機、用於建築量體與都市開放空間的物理導向圖神經網路，以及以開放資料支援都市熱環境下步行的工具。

name: Compliant mechanisms, robotics and fabrication
name_zh: 柔順機構、機器人與構築
label: Fabrication
line: Tensegrity and continuum robots, bamboo cable-strut systems, interlocking formwork and robotic glass.
line_zh: 張拉整體與連續體機器人、竹材索桿系統、互鎖模板與機器人玻璃成形。
summary: Tensegrity and continuum robots, bamboo cable-strut systems, interlocking formwork and robotic glass: low-tech materials met with high-resolution control.
summary_zh: 張拉整體與連續體機器人、竹材索桿系統、互鎖模板與機器人玻璃成形：以高解析度的控制回應低技術的材料。
description: How much intelligence can a construction system carry when the material is cheap, irregular or found? The lab works on compliant and bio-inspired mechanisms (tensegrity, continuum robots, pneumatics), on fabrication strategies for non-developable and curved timber surfaces, and on construction methods for resource-limited conditions, from cable-strut bamboo to free-fall stacking of star-shaped particles.
description_zh: 當材料廉價、不規則或就地取得時，構築系統能承載多少智慧？本脈絡研究柔順與仿生機構（張拉整體、連續體機器人、氣動系統）、非可展與曲面木構的製造策略，以及資源受限條件下的構築方法，從竹材索桿系統到星形顆粒的自由落體堆疊。

name: Sentient and responsive environments
label: Sentient
line: Spaces that sense, learn and answer: light-following rooms, behaviour-driven walls, wearables for emotion.
line_zh: 能感知、學習並回應的空間：追光的房間、由行為驅動的牆、外化情緒的穿戴裝置。
summary: Spaces that sense, learn and answer: light-following rooms, behaviour-driven walls, wearables for emotion, pneumatic haptics for VR.
summary_zh: 能感知、學習並回應的空間：追光的房間、由行為驅動的牆、外化情緒的穿戴裝置、VR 中的氣動觸覺。
description: If a space were a sentient being, how would it recognise you, and how would it answer? This thread treats architecture as an interface: responsive environments controlled by human behaviour, exploratory spaces built on particle life and light sensing, wearable devices for emotional externalisation, natural interfaces for drones, and passive pneumatic haptics for virtual reality.
description_zh: 若空間是有知覺的存在，它會如何辨識你、如何回應？此脈絡將建築視為介面：由人的行為控制的回應式環境、以粒子生命與光感測構成的探索性空間、外化情緒的穿戴裝置、無人機的自然介面，以及虛擬實境中的被動式氣動觸覺。

name: Spatial media and extended reality
label: XR
line: From the CAVE to spatial computing: how representations travel between physical, virtual and hybrid space.
line_zh: 從 CAVE 到空間運算：表徵如何在實體、虛擬與混合空間之間流動。
summary: From the CAVE to spatial computing: how representations travel between physical, virtual and hybrid space, and what changes when they do.
summary_zh: 從 CAVE 到空間運算：表徵如何在實體、虛擬與混合空間之間流動，以及流動時改變了什麼。
description: The lab's longest thread. It began with virtual design collaboration and CAVE navigation in the 1990s and 2000s, and continues today with holographic and metaverse architecture, photogrammetric reconstruction with deep learning, 3D representation of sound, and the transformation of spatial communication media under extended reality.
description_zh: 實驗室最長的研究脈絡。始於 1990 與 2000 年代的虛擬設計協作與 CAVE 導航，延續至今日的全像與元宇宙建築、以深度學習進行攝影測量重建、聲音的三維表徵，以及延展實境下空間傳播媒體的轉變。

name: Form, notation and computational heritage
label: Form
line: Object models, movement notation, dougong topology, the spatial hierarchy of classical gardens, generative tonal art.
line_zh: 物件模型、動作記譜、斗栱拓撲、古典園林的空間層級、生成式調性藝術。
summary: Object models for abstract design concepts, movement notation, dougong topology, the spatial hierarchy of classical gardens, and generative tonal art.
summary_zh: 抽象設計概念的物件模型、動作記譜、斗栱拓撲、古典園林的空間層級，以及生成式調性藝術。
description: What is the right representation for an architectural idea? The thread runs from early work on object modelling and surface synthesis, through notation systems for indeterminacy and chance, to computational readings of dougong joints and classical Chinese gardens, and to artistic rendering workflows that treat points and tones as design material.
description_zh: 一個建築構想的恰當表徵是什麼？此脈絡自早期的物件模型與曲面合成出發，經由記錄不確定性與偶然的記譜系統，延伸至對斗栱節點與中國古典園林的計算性閱讀，以及將點與調性視為設計材料的藝術性算繪流程。
